h1: A brand voice guide so every piece sounds like you
overview: When several people write for one brand, the voice drifts. We study your website, emails and posts, talk through how you want to sound and write a clear guide. It describes your tone in everyday words, lists words to use and avoid, and shows before and after examples from your own copy. We test the guide by rewriting a few of your real texts. It also works as a brief for AI writing tools and freelancers.

faq: What do you need from me?
Links to your site, a few emails or posts you like, and a few notes on how you want to sound. If you have no copy yet, we use a short interview and examples from brands you admire.
Can the guide help my freelancers?
Yes. It is written so a new writer can follow it on day one. The checklist and examples show what to keep and what to change, which cuts back and forth over edits.
Does it work with AI writing tools?
Standard and Premium include a prompt sheet you can paste into AI tools so drafts sound closer to your brand. A person should still review anything before it is published.
Can I update the guide later?
Yes. You receive an editable file. If your brand changes, you can edit it yourself or order a refresh, and we will keep the same structure to keep it easy to follow.
